# Documented skips for the runtime test run WITH ext-curl loaded (the CI gate
# asserts ext-curl is present before Pest runs, so these are the only skips
# allowed). Everything else must execute: the 25 curl-gated tests are covered
# by the exact-match rule (any of them skipping shows up here as unexpected).
# Names are the exact JUnit testcase names emitted by Pest 3 / PHPUnit 11.
it fails closed for live fetches when curl cannot pin the resolved address, in every environment with data set "dataset "testing environment""
it fails closed for live fetches when curl cannot pin the resolved address, in every environment with data set "dataset "production environment""
without curl the command fails closed, keeps the previous files and makes no request
